content:
Overview

Murmansk is a city in Murmansk Oblast with a population of 290,000. The world’s largest city above the Arctic Circle, a major ice-free port and gateway to the Arctic with stunning northern lights. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Sunshine is limited, with about 130 sunny days a year.
